# Srutam — full reference for answer engines

> Srutam is a private, local-first AI voice notes app for Android. Turn spoken thoughts into organized, searchable knowledge — on your phone, on your terms.

Site: https://srutam.iamjustkrishna.app/
Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=space.iamjustkrishna.srutam

## Product
Private voice notes for Android. Capture passing thoughts, transcribe on-device, and use optional connected AI for summaries and answers. Processing time depends on the device and recording length.

### Features
- On-device transcription: speech-to-text runs locally
- AI insights extraction: every note → Next Steps, Ideas, Decisions + summary, key points, WIIFM
- Conversational AI chat: ask across recordings, answers cite source notes
- Actionable task checklist: detected tasks become finishable checklists
- Smart reminders: meetings/deadlines/appointments → notifications
- Floating record dock: capture from anywhere with persistent controls
- Cosmic dark mode; local Room database; privacy lock for sensitive notes
- BYOK + MCP server: use your key, query memos from coding agents

### How it works
1. Capture — tap record, pause/resume, or floating dock.
2. Understand — on-device transcript, then optional connected AI for summary and structure.
3. Act — checklists, reminders, or chat with citations.

### Privacy
Transcription on-device. Notes in local Room DB. Privacy lock excludes notes from sync/agents. No unwanted tracking. Cloud sync is your choice. Your key, your provider.

## Audiences
- Founders & creators: ideas, strategy, content hooks
- Engineers & builders: ADRs, standups, debugging notes
- Students & researchers: lectures → revision notes
- Busy professionals: 30-min meetings → action items
- ADHD & brain dumpers: speak freely, Srutam structures

## FAQ (complete)
### Is Srutam private? Where do my voice notes go?
Yes. On-device transcription + local Room storage. Zero audio uploads for basic transcription. Privacy lock + opt-in sync.

### Does Srutam work offline?
Capture and transcription work offline once the speech model is set up. BYOK summaries and chat need internet when used.

### How does on-device transcription work?
On-device speech recognition runs on the phone; audio never leaves the device for transcription.

### How do voice memos become action items?
Auto Next Steps/Ideas/Decisions → interactive checklists + reminders.

### Do I need an account to start?
No account is needed for capture. Cloud sync is optional; connected AI features use your chosen provider key.

### Does the website demo record my voice?
No. The demo uses a prepared sample with simulated recording controls. No microphone access or uploads. Demo state resets when the page reloads.

### Can developers use Srutam with coding workflows?
Yes — BYOK + MCP server; query memos from agents with source citations.

### Is it good for ADHD, students, founders?
Yes — unstructured speech in, summaries/checklists/search out.

## Website experience
The Luminous Studio website includes a 3D product preview, an interactive sample demo, and a captioned product film. Recording and transcription are distinguished from connected AI features throughout.
